summary: Shows the daily collection amounts categorized by payment mode.
navigation: Fees > Fee Reports > Daily Payment Mode Collection
steps: The report will display total collection for each payment mode (e.g., cash, online) within the selected period.
important_notes: Useful for quickly checking how much was collected through each payment method on a given day or period.
questions: How do I check daily collection by payment mode?
Where can I see how much was collected via cash, online, etc.?
